procedure.method: In this fresh independent session I read the pinned packet, case, rubric, review rules, compact addendum/method and five explicitly pinned native-evidence manifests, and verified the specified bytes and PNG dimensions. The packet declares source_assets:[] and protected_layouts:[], so there were no supplied source images to open and no protected-layout manifests to read. I then called tools.view_image through functions.exec separately for each exact pinned view, with detail original and its image output displayed: M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M4 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M5 native, usage720, thumbnail320. I actually inspected all fifteen displayed images before beginning the first copy-reading/transcription stage, mandatory judgment, image score, or set score. Copy readings were then taken from the displayed pixels, once per entry in packet order, preserving the first observed text and layout separately. No ambiguity-triggered revisits were needed. Native dimensions are 1672x941; usage views are 720x405 and thumbnails 320x180. I made no image edits or substitute views, opened no embedded producer/peer paths, and claim no tool event identifier or runtime session ID.
